verdict.rationale: 2D support is a fair question for a rendering library used to build games, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics or a dedicated 2D workflow. three.js describes itself as a library for creating 3D graphics, and its documented features (cameras, a cube scene, OrbitControls, GLTFLoader) are all 3D-oriented, so there is no evidence 2D is a first-class workflow.
